frozen_scope.same_scope_rule: Brain and Opus 5.5 must be evaluated on the same frozen task population/harness/tool authority unless an absolute/theoretical ceiling is the proof mode.
frozen_scope.scope_ruling: The complete-interface obligation is bound to the frozen Tool Discovery tool authority. Shell, raw HTTP, verification helpers and other internal runtime primitives are not silently reclassified as Tool Discovery tool identities.
frozen_scope.nonclaim: No claim is made that this frozen authority enumerates every present or future tool on the Internet.

interface_contract_property_witnesses.FINITE_DISCOVERY_SOURCE_SET_PER_DECISION: One content-addressed live bound-capability authority snapshot is the discovery source for the frozen decision epoch.
interface_contract_property_witnesses.DISCOVERY_RECEIPT_IDENTIFIES_QUERIED_SOU: Receipt binds source id, registry blob, astra runtime blob and content-derived epoch.
interface_contract_property_witnesses.DISCOVERY_RESULTS_MONOTONICALLY_ADD_VISI: One exact complete receipt materializes all authority identities before policy reasoning; partial or tampered receipts are rejected.
interface_contract_property_witnesses.UNION_OF_AUTHORITATIVE_DISCOVERY_RESULTS: Discovery enumerates exactly the keys of the same registry that _invoke_bound_capability uses to authorize identities.
interface_contract_property_witnesses.DISCOVERED_TOOL_METADATA_CORRECT_FOR_AVA: Projection reads the same immutable registry records; only VERIFIED_BOUND_CAPABILITY zero-spend entries are admitted.
interface_contract_property_witnesses.SAFE_CAPABILITY_PROBE_RECEIPTS_ARE_TRUTH: Probe reveals membership in the hidden provides set only for the exact verified registry blob and exact content-derived epoch.
interface_contract_property_witnesses.VERSION_EPOCH_STABLE_DURING_ONE_SELECTIO: Any registry byte change violates the pinned blob/epoch and fails closed before reuse.
